from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class INA226_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x4127,  # CONFIG
            0x01: 0x0000,  # SHUNT_VOLTAGE
            0x02: 0x0000,  # BUS_VOLTAGE
            0x03: 0x0000,  # POWER
            0x04: 0x0000,  # CURRENT
            0x05: 0x0000,  # CALIBRATION
            0x06: 0x0000,  # MASK_ENABLE
            0x07: 0x0000,  # ALERT_LIMIT
            0xFE: 0x5449,  # MANUFACTURER_ID
            0xFF: 0x2260   # DIE_ID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr in self.regs:
            return self.regs[addr]
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address {addr}")

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr == 0x00:  # CONFIG
            if nbytes == 1:
                # Update only bits 15:8
                data &= 0xFF00
            self.regs[addr] = data
        elif addr == 0x05:  # CALIBRATION
            if nbytes == 1:
                # Update only bits 14:0
                data &= 0x0FFF
            self.regs[addr] = data
        elif addr == 0x06:  # MASK_ENABLE
            if nbytes == 1:
                # Update only bits 15:0
                data &= 0x0FFF
            self.regs[addr] = data
        elif addr == 0xFE:  # MANUFACTURER_ID
            # READ ONLY
            pass
        elif addr == 0xFF:  # DIE_ID
            # READ ONLY
            pass
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address {addr}")

from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class INA226_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Initialize registers with their reset values
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x4127,
            0x01: 0x0000,
            0x02: 0x0000,
            0x03: 0x0000,
            0x04: 0x0000,
            0x05: 0x0000,
            0x06: 0x0000,
            0x07: 0x0000,
            0xFE: 0x5449,
            0xFF: 0x2260
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Register address {addr} not found")
        return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Register address {addr} not found")
        if addr == 0xFE:  # MANUFACTURER_ID should never be written
            raise ValueError("MANUFACTURER_ID is a read-only register")
        if addr == 0xFF:  # DIE_ID should never be written
            raise ValueError("DIE_ID is a read-only register")
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Update only the lower 8 bits of the register
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) | (data & 0xFF)
        else:
            # Update the entire register with the provided data
            self.regs[addr] = data
